propositions: Every command's runtime parsing and generated syntax must derive from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory with no manual syntax authority or docs-only parser.
All visible canonical commands must appear once in the overview; top-level help forms return byte-current generated package data before operation/config/mount/handler execution.
Exact, compatibility, hidden, and retired command spellings (including jira-onboard and purge-bridge) must exhibit approved behavior and remain unknown/helpable as specified.
Lazy execution must preserve mount/init, argv, confirmation, stream, exit-code, and legacy-output contracts except for explicit help normalization.
CLI reference generation, coverage checks, and wheel validation must enumerate registries and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command censuses.
Advanced command parsers must avoid latent argparse.HelpFormatter regressions and maintain registry-wide help-generation uniformity across Python versions.
